main_text.p: ingentes calores æstiuos mitigat, homines & animalia recreat, Leuit.26.v.3.4. Deut.11.v.13.14.c.28.v.12.Iacob.5. v.18.Esa.30.v.23.Psal.104.v.13.14.15.16.Act.14.v.17. Idem gignit guttas roris, quo terra mirum in modum fœcundatur,Iob.38.v.28.Prou.3.v.20.Genes.27.v.30.Deut.33.v.13.28.Zachar.8.v.12.Idem deiicit grandinem e cœlo, Psalm. 147.v.17. Iob.38.v.22.23. Exod.9.verf.17.18.19.22.&seqq. Iof.10.v.11.Psal.78.v.47.48. Idem e thesauris suis producit ventos,Psal.135.v.6.7.Ierem.10.v.13.c.51.v.16.Exod.10.v.13.19.Num.11.v.31. Amos.4.v.13.Ion.1.v.4. Idem volat super alas venti, Psalm.18.v.11.&104.v.3. Idem creat fulgetrum, tanquam anteambulonem suæ maiestatis, Psal.18.v.13.&50.v.3. Idem edit vocem suam fortissimam,tonitru, Psalm.29.Exod.19.v.16.c.20. v.18. 1.Sam.12.verf.18.19.20.Iob.40.verf.3.4. Idem creat terræmotum, Psal.18.verf.8. Matth.ij 28.verf.2.

7. Mineralia, siue fossilia, id est, lapides vulgares & pretiosi, metalla, succi item & terræ metallares, partim ma-iestatem, partim beneficia & iudicia Dei nobis ponunt ob oculos. Iob.28.v.13. & seqq. Exod.28. Genes.19.v.24.10 25.&c.14.v.3.
8. Planta, seu stirpes, sunt documenta paternæ Dei curæ, Gen.1.v.29.30.c.2.v.16.Psal.104.v.14.15.
9. Volatilia testantur de potentia, sapientia & providentia Dei. Iob.39.v.2.16.17.&seqq. Matth.6.v.26. 4
10. Aquatilia narrant nobis sapientiam, potentiam,& providentiam Dei, Iob.12.v.8. Psal.104.v.25. 26.27. Iob.26.v.13. & seqq.
11. Bruta terrestria docent nos Deum esse, & esse sapientem, potentem,& bonum,Iob.12.v.7. 30
12. Homo, constans anima rationali & corpore organico, in se habet satis miraculorum & oraculorum,quibus nunquam non admonetur de natura & cura Dei. Gen.2.Iob.10.v.10.11.
Confer supra cum Physicis, & infra cum ζωοπ[?] θεία[?], &c.

page.notes: The Greek words after "cum" are only partly legible on the scan; the letters are marked [?]. The small right-margin marks ("ij", "10", "4", "30") are printed marginal numerals of uncertain function, transcribed where they stand. The paragraph numbers 7 to 12 are printed as set. The printed "ma-iestatem" is shown with its line-end hyphen joined.
